movie_title: What is surf and turf? 6 Minute English
introduction: Improve your English vocabulary and speaking with 6 Minute English! Shopping online is a popular act

vocabulary.definition: to remove someone from a place or organization, possibly because they've broken the rules or behaved badly
vocabulary.example: If we don’t finish the program on time, we might be turfed out of this studio.

vocabulary.definition: the place where you pay for your shopping, either in a real shop or online
vocabulary.example: Don't forget to check out at the checkout before leaving the store.

vocabulary.definition: businesses that sell things to customers
vocabulary.example: Online retailers offer a wide range of products for convenient shopping.

vocabulary.definition: too old or no longer suitable for current use
vocabulary.example: The software became out of date and required an update to function properly.

vocabulary.definition: to make a mistake and get into trouble with someone or something
vocabulary.example: He fell foul of the law by ignoring the traffic regulations.

vocabulary.definition: an expression for online shopping without making a purchase; putting items in your basket but never buying them
vocabulary.example: Many online shoppers engage in surf and turf, adding items to their cart but not completing the purchase.
